bar_delimiters.metrics: vertical span and midpoint stem weight from parenleft at each master
bar_delimiters.scope: paired bars at run start or after closure-introducing punctuation / keywords; bounded parameter-like content

code.generic_policy: Tall < by default; short between whitespace on both sides or lowercase/digit/underscore operands. Adjacent words containing uppercase letters retain tall generics (bounded32glyph context). Greater-than policy unchanged.
code.generic_height: halfway between comparison and bracket height, centered within baseline/cap-height limits
code.period_policy: all syntax periods use the unscaled source diamond; only positions change

rust_lifetime.policy: ASCII apostrophe before identifier starts; quoted identifiers up to 32 letters/digits retain normal quote. Nearby-character heuristic does not parse source strings/comments.
rust_lifetime.pair_fitting: Center of opening quote sits on boundary before following character cell; < and & shift exactly600units right. Original advances retained.
rust_lifetime.default: Opening single quote in its normal cell under calt; compact placement disabled by default.

code.unicode_ellipsis: one-cell U+2026 uses three full-size source periods; ASCII ... retains three cells

sans.fractions: frac, numr, dnom; reuses source-designed super/sub digits; new variable fraction slash; multi-digit numeric sequences
sans.oldstyle_note: 0/1/2 at x-height,3/4/5/7/9 descend,6/8 retain ascenders; uniform sizing with stroke compensation; review trial

system.fractions: frac, numr, dnom; reuses source-designed super/sub digits; new variable fraction slash; multi-digit numeric sequences
system.oldstyle_note: 0/1/2 at x-height,3/4/5/7/9 descend,6/8 retain ascenders; uniform sizing with stroke compensation; review trial
